description: Get comprehensive details about a specific tokenized property on Fabrica (Ethereum Mainnet), including legal description, valuation, property tax status, Property checks (with their 5-digit numeric encoding), current ownership and holders, active loans, marketplace listings and offers, recent activity, photos and a parcel map image link. Also its lifecycle stage (premint, minted, removal in progress), fees assessed on the token with approval and payment state (fees is null when none are assessed), and flags for a duplicate parcel claim or the marketplace screen (an empty list when none apply). An old premint ID that was replaced by a minted token returns the successor. Boundary geometry is returned by get_property_map. The response includes the URL of the operating agreement (the trust instrument) that governs the token; get_trust_documents returns the full legal record.

tokenId.description: The token ID of the property
